verdict.rationale: Firestore docs say it keeps data in sync across client apps through realtime listeners, and that apps can listen to and query data even offline. A hands-on community report describes multiple clients syncing in real time on the original Firebase. Together these directly cover subscribing to live changes without polling. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the listener API (query-level subscriptions, change event types, unsubscribe semantics), recent independent hands-on corroboration (the community report is over 10 years old).
